captions.detailed: This 3D model is a rectangular battery compartment cover with rounded corners. It features a flexible, loop-style locking clip on one of its shorter ends and two rectangular ear tabs on the opposite end to secure the cover in place. The main plate is flat and thin, with precise rectangular cutouts near the clip and the ear tabs to allow proper engagement with a device housing.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric battery cover in OpenSCAD with adjustable length, width, thickness, and corner radius. It must include customizable ear tabs on one side (defining their width, length, and spacing) and an integrated flexible locking clip on the opposite side with adjustable width, length, and catch depth.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a main 'cover' module and a helper 'clip' module. The main cover body starts with a 2D minkowski sum of a cube and a cylinder to round the corners, which is then unioned with two rectangular ear tabs (cubes) and optional gussets. A difference operation cuts out a rectangular slot for the clip and trims the ear notches. The complex locking clip is constructed in its own module using a hull of cylinders to form the curved profile, unioned with a tab cube, and then hollowed out using a difference operation with smaller inner hulls and trimming cubes.
